zic_check.$comment: Per zone, [count, sha256] of its UTC offset changes inside range (from January 1 of the first year to January 1 of the second, UTC) as zic(8) compiles them and zdump(8) prints them. The digest is over JSON.stringify([initial, changes]): initial is the offset in seconds at the start of the range, and changes lists [unix_seconds, offset_seconds] for each change.
